Textiles and apparel remain central to the challenge. The sector brought in $18bn in FY26, about 60pc of all exports. They grew 0.3pc in a year when everything else fell. The sector's own figures show 83pc of it is finished goods, up from 77pc in FY22. That sounds like progress, but most of it is basic: knitwear, bedwear and made-up articles, and plain garments.

These are crowded, low-margin segments where buyers shift orders for a few cents. Three markets, the EU, the US and the UK, take about three-quarters of textile exports. The US alone accounts for roughly a fifth of all Pakistani exports.

Why cannot Pakistani exporters compete? The causes are well known and slow to change. Export competitiveness is undermined by high energy and financing costs, a tax system that ties up working capital through advance payments and delayed refunds, and tariffs that make imported raw materials expensive.

Frequent import restrictions and abrupt policy reversals add uncertainty. Beyond these immediate costs, weak productivity, inadequate testing and certification, and limited investment in technology, product development and branding prevent firms from moving into higher-value segments. The result is an industry struggling to compete on price while failing to build the capabilities needed to compete on quality, innovation and value addition.

A proposal recently put forward by a prominent business leader from Lahore deserves serious consideration. As reported in the media, it calls for exporters to receive a rebate of up to 8pc against eligible domestic taxes if they increase their manufactured merchandise shipments by at least 10pc annually. The attraction is straightforward: rather than offering blanket subsidies to exporters regardless of their performance, the government would reward those who demonstrate measurable growth in foreign sales.

The numbers are compelling. For example, starting from textile exports of $18bn, a 10pc annual increase would take them to about $19.8bn in the first year and $20.7bn in the second. By the third year, exports would reach approximately $23.4bn. That would add roughly $5.4bn to annual textile export earnings compared with the FY26 baseline. These are projections, not guaranteed outcomes, but they show the potential scale of the prize.

The logic has appeal. Pakistan has just paid about 7.7pc on average to borrow $3bn. Why not pay a similar price to those who bring dollars in? There is also a difference that matters. The bond has to be repaid with interest. A rebate is a one-time cost on earnings that stay in the country. And unlike past schemes, it would reward only those who actually grow instead of handing every exporter a subsidy for standing still.

A carefully designed export incentive could help generate recurring foreign exchange earnings without creating a corresponding external debt liability. The comparison is not exact: a domestic tax rebate costs revenue, while bond interest is a financing expense. Nevertheless, it highlights the economic value of encouraging exporters to earn dollars rather than repeatedly borrowing them.

The proposal's strongest feature is its performance condition. Past export incentives have often been criticised for rewarding established exporters without requiring commensurate gains in productivity, investment or foreign sales. A scheme tied to annual export growth would create a clearer incentive to find new customers, increase capacity, improve quality and move towards higher-value products. It could also encourage businesses that have remained content with existing markets to seek new opportunities.

However, the scheme must be designed carefully. An 8pc rebate should not become another open-ended subsidy on existing exports. Eligibility should be based on verified export receipts, with a transparent baseline and safeguards against inflated invoices, related-party transactions, artificial price increases and the shifting of shipments between companies.

Rebates should be capped by eligible domestic taxes actually paid, and their fiscal cost should be disclosed. Government must also distinguish genuine additional exports from shipments brought forward from the following year or gains caused solely by higher international prices.

The incentive should reward sustained expansion, not just volume. Exporters investing in higher-value products, new markets, technology, worker skills, energy efficiency and compliance with international standards should be well placed to benefit. Small and medium-sized firms should not be excluded by cumbersome procedures or an inability to navigate the tax system. Independent evaluation should establish whether the scheme generates additional exports and jobs at a reasonable fiscal cost.

That said, the proposal does not fix the underlying costs. A rebate is a bandage on power tariffs, interest rates and refund delays. If the energy and tax burdens that made Pakistani goods expensive remain, the rebate becomes a permanent crutch, and the government will find it hard to withdraw.

Police and protesters clashed violently in Paris and other French cities on Saturday on the sidelines of nationwide marches against soaring inflation, with one demonstrator's hand blown off, multiple blazes set, and looters breaking into dozens of stores to strip them bare.

With just months to go before the two-round elections in April and May to choose Macron's successor, the demonstrations follow weeks of high-schoolstudent blockadesdemanding better learning conditions.

Macron and his government were criticised by many of the demonstrators, who numbered 500,000 across the country, according to the CGT union. Authorities did not immediately give their estimate of the numbers.

Police used tear gas and water cannon against masked protesters in Paris and other cities who were throwing projectiles and aiming fireworks. Several parked cars were torched in the capital, and more than 130 arrests were made.

In the southern city of Saint-Etienne, a male protester had his hand blown off by a police crowd-control grenade, a police source toldAFP. His maiming came after a 15-year-old lost his hand on October 5 to a police stun grenade during another protest in the city of Lens.

The protests geared up with a handful of gatherings nationwide on Saturday morning,AFPreporters said.

In Lyon, protesters set ablaze a tourist office in the city centre, and smashed their way into town halls in the cities of Marseille and Lille, where they vandalised the premises before leaving.

Dozens of shops were looted, including many in Marseille, among them a Hermes boutique, an Apple store in Lille, several shops in Nice and at least one mobile phone outlet in Paris,AFPjournalists saw.

A crowd of more than 300 protesters tried to move up Paris's Champs-Elysees, home to flagship luxury stores. As police firing tear gas blocked their way, they yelled, "All cops are bastards".

In the western city of Rennes, around 20 people set up a barricade using trash bins and large pallets on the outskirts of a shopping mall.

PARIS: The French government said on Wednesday it was pausing the use of stun grenades in its policing of student protests, after a 15-year-old boy's hand was blown off during a clash with riot police, fuelling protesters' accusations of police brutality.

Protests showed no sign of easing, with more than 500 schools closed a day after demonstrations swept across the country, and unions representing high-school students, teachers and other workers planning more marches for Thursday.

The wave of protests has been going on for more than two weeks and has exposed widespread public anger six months ahead of an election to replace President Emmanuel Macron. Speaking to the nation on Wednesday evening, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said the government would review the demands made by students and present proposals at the end of October on issues ranging from renovating buildings to make more teachers available, but gave no details.

"In the past, too many promises were not kept, quite simply because they were untenable," Lecornu said. "What I want are concrete, quick and fully funded answers." The lack of an immediate government response, which was decried by student leaders after talks at the education ministry earlier on Wednesday, appeared unlikely to quell the protests.

At Lycee Lamartine, a high school in central Paris, protesters sang the Marseillaise, chanted slogans and performed Mexican waves as they blockaded the entrance to the school.

"We saw there were lots of crumbling walls, a shortage of teachers in public schools, absent teachers," said Gabriel Fillieule, who used to attend a public school but now goes to a private one. He and others said they were protesting to demand better learning conditions for all.

PARIS: UN chief Antonio Guterres said on Thursday that the  "war on nature has not yet ended" as he launched a report showing the world was falling short of its biodiversity commitments. Nations will assess progress and pitfalls toward a 2030 goal to stop the destruction of nature when they meet in Armenia next week for the UN biodiversity negotiations.

Nearly 200 countries joined the landmark  "Paris Agreement for Nature" four years ago but have been slow to act on its objectives. The pact laid out 23 targets for halting and reversing nature loss by 2030, including reducing pollution, protecting threatened species and conserving 30pc of the world's land and oceans.

But many of these targets are off track, said Guterres as he launched a global report spotlighting the gaps between ambition and action. "It's not all bad news... There is progress, but not enough. We are far from what is necessary," he told reporters in the Armenian capital Yerevan where the COP17 talks start on Monday.

"The report shows that many of the critical elements of progress... are still missing in action".

اطلاعات کے مطابق روسی وزیر خارجہ نے انڈیا کے وزیر خارجہ ایس جے شنکر سے اپنی بات چیت میں تیل اور گیس سستے داموں پر فراہم کرنے کی پیشکش کی ہے۔ دونوں رہنماؤں نے خریداری کے لیے ادائیگی کے طریقۂ کار پر غور و خوض بھی کیا ہے۔ جے شنکر نے روسی رہنما سے ایس۔400 مزائل سسٹم کے سامان اور سپلائی پر بھی بات کی ہے۔

ایس جے شنکر نے کہا کہ یہ ملاقات انتہائی مشکل بین الاقوامی حالات میں ہو رہی ہے۔

روسی وزیر خارجہ کے یہ بیانات ایک ایسے وقت میں آئے ہیں جب ان کے دلی پہنچنے سے ذرا پہلے امریکہ کے قومی سلامتی کے نائب مشیر دلیپ سنگھ نے انڈیا کو متنبہ کیا تھا کہ وہ روس سے تجارت کرنے سے باز رہے۔ 'امریکہ یہ نہیں چاہتا کہ انڈیا روس سے تیل، گیس اور وہ تمام اشیا جن پر پابندیاں عائد کی گئی ہیں، ان کی درآمدات میں اضافہ کرے۔ جو ممالک روس پر لگائی گئی پابندیوں سے بچ کر روس سے لین دین کی کوشش کریں گے انھیں اس کے مضمرات کا سامنا کرنا پڑے گا۔'

انھوں نے یہ بات ان خبروں کے بعد کی جن میں کہا جا رہا تھا کہ انڈیا روس سے سستے داموں پر تیل اور گیس خریدنے کا معاہدہ کرنے والا ہے۔ انھوں نے مزید کہا کہ کسی کو بھرم میں نہیں رہنا چاہیئے کہ روس اور چین کے تعلقات میں روس کی حیثیت ایک جونئیر پارٹنر کی ہو گی۔ 'چین موجودہ بحران میں روس کے مقابلے میں جتنا مضبوط ہو گا اتنا ہی انڈیا کے لیے یہ نقصان دہ ثابت ہو گا۔' انھوں نے کہا کہ 'میرے خیال میں یہ کسی کے گمان میں بھی نہیں ہو گا کہ اگر چین دوبارہ انڈیا کی سرحدوں پر حملہ کرتا ہے تو روس اس کے دفاع کے لیے آئے گا۔'

امریکی مخالفت کے باوجود روس اور انڈیا میں قربتیں کیوں بڑھ رہی ہیں؟

ان کے اس بیان پر انڈیا کے سفارتی حلقوں میں شدید رد علم ہوا ہے۔ اقوام متحدہ میں انڈیا کے سابق سفیر سید اکبرالدین نے ایک ٹویٹ پیغام میں کہا کہ 'امریکی مشیر نے جو زبان استعمال کی ہے وہ سفارتی نہیں بلکہ دھمکی کی زبان ہے۔'

خارجی امور کے تجزیہ کار زور آور دولت سنگھ نے ٹویٹر پر اپنے ردعمل میں کہا کہ 'امریکی اور یورپی اہلکار اپنے برانگیختہ کرنے والے بیانات سے اپنی حدیں پار کر گئے ہیں۔'

امریکہ کے قومی سلامتی کے مشیر دلیپ سنگھ کو روس کے خلاف پابندیوں کا معمار سمجھا جاتا ہے۔ وہ امریکی صدر جو بائڈن کے مشیر کے طور پر پر دلی آئے تاکہ انڈیا کو روس سے کسی طرح کی سودے بازے سے روکا جا سکے۔ وہ انڈیا کو یوکرین پر روسی حملے کے سلسلے میں امریکہ کا ہمنوا بنانے کے مقصد سے آئے تھے۔ انڈیا نے اقوام متحدہ میں روس کے خلاف امریکہ اور یورپی ملکوں کی سبھی قراردادوں پر ابھی تک ووٹنگ میں غیر جانبدار موقف اختیار کیا ہے۔

انڈیا پر امریکہ اور یورپی ممالک شدید دباؤ ڈال رہے ہیں کو وہ یوکرین کے بحران میں روس کے خلاف پوزیشن لے۔ گزشتہ دنوں جرمنی کے قومی سلامتی کے مشیر اسی مقصد سے دلی آئے تھے۔ برطانیہ کی وزیر خارجہ لیز ٹرس کے ساتھ ایک مذاکرے میں حصہ لیتے ہوئے انڈیا کے وزیر خارجہ ایس جے شنکر نے کہا تھا کہ 'تیل اور گیس کی قیمتوں میں اضافے کے بعد انڈیا فطری طور پر دوسری مارکیٹ تلاش کرے گا جہاں اسے سستے دام پر تیل مل سکے۔

انڈیا اپنی ضروریات کا بیشتر تیل مشرق وسطیٰ سے خریدتا ہے۔ روس سے وہ اپنی ضروریات کا صرف ایک فیصد تیل خریدتا ہے۔ ہم امریکہ سے تقر یبآ آٹھ فیصد تیل خریدتے ہیں، یورپی ممالک روس سے 15 فیصد سے زیادہ تیل خریدتے ہیں۔ تین مہینے بعد جب اس کا تجزیہ کیا جائے گا کہ روس سے کس نے کتنا تیل خریدا تو انڈیا یقیناً ٹاپ دس ملکوں میں نہیں ہو گا۔'

جون 2020 میں لداخ میں سرحدوں پر چین سے خونریز جھڑپ کے بعد انڈیا رفتہ رفتہ امریکہ کی طرف مائل ہو گیا تھا۔ اس نے امریکہ۔جاپان اور آسٹریلیا کے ساتھ 'کواڈ ' نام کے اتحاد کی شمولیت اختیار کی۔ وہ یہ امید کر رہا تھا کہ امریکہ انڈیا کے سرحدی تنازعے میں چین کے خلاف زیادہ سخت موقف اختیار کرے گا۔ لیکن رفتہ رفتہ انڈیا کا یہ بھرم ٹوٹنے لگا۔ گزشتہ ڈیڑھ برس میں روس نے کئی مرحلوں پر چین سے کشیدگی کم کرانے میں انڈیا کی مدد کی ہے۔ روس اس کا ایک قابلِ اعتبار اور مستقل اتحادی بنا رہا ہے۔ یوکرین پر روس کے حملے کے بعد انڈیا میں یہ سوچ گھر کر گئی ہے کہ انڈیا کو کسی ٹکراؤ کی صورت میں اپنا دفاع خود کرنا ہو گا اور کوئی اس کی مدد کو نہیں آئے گا۔

انڈیا کو پتہ ہے کہ اگر یورپی ممالک اپنی ضروریات کا 15 فیصد تیل روس سے خریدتے رہے اور ان پر پابندیوں کا کوئی اثر نہیں ہو گا تو پھر انڈیا بھی روس سے تیل اور ہتھیار وغیرہ خریدنے کا مجاز ہے۔ انڈیا نے جو پوزیشن اختیار کی ہے اس نے امریکہ کے لیے ایک پیچیدہ صورت پیدہ کر دی ہے۔ امریکہ کی براہ راست تنبیہ کے باوجود انڈیا اپنے موقف سے ہٹتا ہوا نظر نہیں آ رہا ہے۔

The countries facing the largest food crises are Nigeria, Congo, Sudan, Yemen, Afghan­istan, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan, South Sudan and Syria.

In Pakistan, persistent poverty, high food inflation, rising living costs, limited employment opportunities and declining household incomes continue to erode families' purchasing power. Unfavourable agricultural prices and broader economic instability have further undermined livelihoods, leaving millions struggling to afford adequate food.

As humanitarian needs outstrip available resources, vulnerable households are increasingly resorting to damaging coping strategies, including cutting food consumption, selling productive assets and withdrawing children from school to cope with financial pressures.

The report cautions that these measures may provide temporary relief but can deepen poverty, undermine children's education and nutrition, and weaken families' ability to recover from future shocks.

Limited access to healthcare, nutrition services, clean water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH), and social protection is compounding the crisis, particularly in rural and disaster-affected areas. Persistent poverty and acute malnutrition remain major drivers of humanitarian needs, while cuts to support services and livelihood programmes are further eroding community resilience.

Pakistan's exposure to climate-related disasters remains a major source of food insecurity. Recurrent floods, droughts, heatwaves, glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) and increasingly erratic monsoon rainfall have damaged infrastructure, reduced agricultural production and weakened livestock-dependent livelihoods.

Crop losses and prolonged dry spells have also increased households' reliance on markets for food at a time when many families have limited purchasing power. Several districts are experiencing prolonged drought conditions, adding to concerns about agricultural output and rural incomes.

The report warns that seasonal hardships can intensify these pressures. The lean season from December 2025 to March 2026, characterised in some areas by extended winter conditions and heavy snowfall, was identified as a period likely to worsen food insecurity by restricting access to markets and essential resources.

Insecurity and regional tensions are adding another layer of pressure to Pakistan's already fragile food security situation.

According to the report, localised insecurity in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan continues to disrupt livelihoods, restrict access to markets and hamper humanitarian operations.
output: The countries with the biggest food crises include Nigeria, Congo, Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Pakistan, South Sudan and Syria. In Pakistan, poverty, food inflation, rising costs, limited jobs and low incomes are cutting into purchasing power. Purchasing power means how many things you can buy with your money. Food inflation means food prices keep going up. For example, if the price of flour goes up and the salary stays the same, a household can buy less flour than before. Weak households are doing things like eating less food, selling their assets and taking children out of school. According to the report, these steps can increase poverty and harm children's education and nutrition. Limited access to healthcare, nutrition, clean water, sanitation, hygiene and social protection is making the crisis worse. Social protection means help from the government that supports weak people in hard times. In Pakistan, floods, droughts, heatwaves, glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) — that is, floods that come when a glacier lake bursts — and irregular monsoon rains have damaged farm production. The lean season from December 2025 to March 2026 can increase food insecurity. The lean season is the time when the old crop is finished and the new one has not come yet. Food insecurity means not getting enough safe food. In Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan, local insecurity is affecting jobs, markets and aid operations. Local insecurity means unrest in the area.

The second phase is now understood to have been scrapped.

A South Korean military official toldAFPthat Seoul viewed the decision as "unusual".

Nuclear-armed North Korea has long voiced outrage at the exercises, considering them dress rehearsals for an invasion.

Wednesday's commentary by the state-runKorean Central News Agencysaid they pose "the most immediate and open threat" to North Korea and "regional security".

It did not mention Trump's order or his desire to resume talks with Kim, with whom he has hinted at being in contact.

Hong Min, a senior researcher at the Korea Institute for National Unification, said Pyongyang had deliberately avoided mentioning Trump.

North Korea was "sticking to general principles as if completely unaware of" Trump's comments, he toldAFP.

"Showing awareness could suggest a degree of mutual understanding," but feigning ignorance signals that the issue could become a key bargaining point in any future talks with Trump, Hong said.

In the initialannouncementon his Truth Social platform, Trump described the drills as unfriendly towards a country that had been respectful to him.

South Korea's Foreign Minister Cho Hyun told lawmakers on Wednesday that Seoul had not been informed in advance of Trump's plan to downsize them.
output: Log ab samajh rahe hain ke military exercises ka doosra hissa cancel ho gaya hai. South Korea ke ek fauji official ne AFP ko bataya ke Seoul is faisle ko ajeeb samajhta hai. North Korea ke paas nuclear weapons hain. Woh in exercises par lambe arse se naraz hai. Woh inhein hamle ki practice kehta hai. Wednesday ko government-run Korean Central News Agency ne ek comment mein kaha ke yeh exercises North Korea aur region ki security ke liye sab se foran aur khula khatra hain. Region ki security ka matlab hai us region mein peace aur safety. Is comment mein Trump ke order ya Kim ke saath baatein dobara shuru karne ki khwahish ka zikr nahi kiya gaya. Hong Min, Korea Institute for National Unification ke senior researcher hain. Unhon ne kaha ke Pyongyang ne jaan boojh kar Trump ka zikr nahi kiya. Unhon ne kaha yeh masla Trump ke saath aage ki baatein mein bargaining ka important point ban sakta hai. Bargaining ka important point matlab aisi baat jis se baat cheet mein apni baat manwai ja sake. Trump ne apne Truth Social platform par pehle elaan mein exercises ko ek aise mulk ke liye unfriendly kaha jo un ke saath izzat se pesh aaya tha. South Korea ki Foreign Minister Cho Hyun ne Wednesday ko law banane walon ko bataya ke Seoul ko Trump ke exercises chhoti karne ke plan ke baare mein pehle se nahi bataya gaya tha.

ISLAMABAD: The power division on Thurs­day projected an additional fuel cost adjustment (FCA) of Rs2.56 per unit for electricity consumed in September, translating into an estimated Rs32.7 billion burden on consumers in November bills.

In a statement, the division said the adjustment would have been significantly higher, by around Rs3.44 per unit, but targe­ted load management hel­ped contain the price shock.

"The Ministry of Energy (Power Division) has aver­ted a potential Rs5-6 per unit hike in the September 2026 Fuel Price Adjust­ment (FPA) through timely measures, including targeted load management, limiting the projected adjustment to Rs2.56 per unit despite rising international fuel prices and constraints on LNG supplies," the statement said.

Over the past two mon­ths, the power division has started issuing advance estimates before the Cen­tral Power Purchasing Agency (CPPA) formally makes the regulatory filing required for monthly fuel cost adjustments.

"Targeted load management and other measures helped limit the impact of expensive fuels used for power generation, saving consumers from an additional burden of up to Rs3.44 per unit," the division said.

It confirmed that targeted load management of around two to two-and-a-half hours during September helped reduce reliance on costly alternative fuels, including furnace oil and high-speed diesel and contain the anticipated increase in the FCA.

The division added that supplying imported re-gasified liquefied natural gas (RLNG) for power generation at domestic gas prices had further eased the burden on consumers by 83 paise per unit.

"Consequently, the September FPA is expected to be Rs1.45 per unit higher than that of August," the statement said. The August FCA was Rs1.11 per unit, while the estimated financial impact of the September adjustment is Rs32.7bn on consumers' electricity bills in November.

The power division said international fuel prices had risen sharply amid regional conflicts and disruptions to fuel supply chains following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude prices had surged beyond $120 per barrel, compared with the benchmark of around $70 per barrel assumed while determining the base electricity tariff.

Despite Qatar's declaration of force majeure, Pakistan continued efforts to meet its RLNG requirements through available contracted supplies and additional spot cargoes where necessary, it added.

The division also claimed that the combined impact of fuel price adjustments and quarterly tariff adjustments during January-August had been limited to 65 paise per unit, equivalent to an increase of only 1.9pc over the base electricity tariff.

It attributed this partly to tariff rationalisation measures and an additional electricity consumption package for industrial and agricultural consumers, which it said encouraged greater use of power from the national grid.

However, industrial consumers have disputed the claimed benefits of the support package. They contend that the Rs22.96 per unit marginal cost rate benefits only a limited number of consumers, while an actual marginal cost of around Rs34 per unit results in an additional burden of about Rs11 per unit being fed into the average tariff, putting a burden on all consumers.

At their request, Nepra last week held a public hearing on revising or suspending the incremental package, but a decision is still awaited.

The power division said it was continuing to monitor developments in international fuel markets and supply chains while taking measures to minimise the impact of external price shocks on electricity consumers.
output: Power Division ne Thursday ko kaha ke September mein jo bijli use hui, us par Rs2.56 per unit extra fuel cost adjustment lag sakta hai. Fuel cost adjustment ka matlab hai ke fuel ki qeemat mein farq ki wajah se bijli ke rate barh jate hain. Andaza hai ke November ke bills mein consumers par Rs32.7 billion ka bojh parega. Power Division ke mutabiq targeted load management ki wajah se yeh barhna taqreeban Rs3.44 per unit kam hua. Targeted load management ka matlab hai bijli ki demand ko plan ke mutabiq kam karna. Statement mein kaha gaya ke September 2026 ki fuel price adjustment mein Rs5-6 per unit ka possible increase tha, lekin usay limit kar ke Rs2.56 per unit rakha gaya. Imported RLNG ko gharailu gas ki qeemat par bijli banane ke liye dene se consumers par bojh 83 paise per unit aur kam hua. September ka FPA August ke muqable Rs1.45 per unit zyada expect kiya ja raha hai; August ka FCA Rs1.11 per unit tha. Power Division ne kaha ke region ke conflicts aur Strait of Hormuz band hone ke baad Brent crude ki qeemat $120 per barrel se upar chali gayi, jabke base tariff mein taqreeban $70 per barrel ka andaza liya gaya tha. Qatar ke force majeure announce karne ke bawajood Pakistan ne RLNG ki zaroorat poori karne ki koshishein jari rakhein. Force majeure ka matlab hai aisi majboori jis mein koi company apna wada poora nahi kar sakti.

THE purge of millions of voters from India's electoral rolls has sparked widespread demonstrations, spearheaded by young protesters calling for justice. The Cockroach Janta Party is at the forefront of the movement, while more established opposition parties, such as Congress, are also participating actively. The thread uniting these groups is their suspicion that the Indian election commission has been tinkering with the rolls to benefit the ruling BJP.

Earlier this year, the youth-led CJP organised a massive anti-government campaign calling for the resignation of the education minister over exam irregularities. The movement succeeded in ousting the minister, with the youthful energy of its participants catching the BJP government off guard. This time too, India's rulers have responded with brute force, bundling away thousands of protesters, including Rahul Gandhi and CJP leaders, and cutting off access to the iconic Jantar Mantar protest site in Delhi.

Around 130m names have been removed from the electoral rolls. The Indian election authorities say the deleted names include voters who have died, relocated, or could not be traced. But the Indian opposition has dismissed this explanation. It is believed that many of the deleted voters were Muslims, as well as those belonging to other marginalised groups.

Moreover, media reports say that the Indian election commissioner — whose resignation is being demanded — ignored objections from within the commission to the deletion of such a large number of voters. Such purging of the rolls is in keeping with the BJP regime's marginalisation of vulnerable groups. It has employed lawfare and dubious means in the past as well to delete Muslim votes; millions have been disenfranchised through the National Register of Citizens.

Earlier, the BJP and its Hindutva cohorts could get away with trampling the rights of Indian Muslims. But now, their shenanigans are not working. It appears that India's other communities are also tired of Hindutva's empty promises and its attempt to remake India in its own image through fair means and foul. The Sangh Parivar has run out of ideas, and its fantasies about a glorious Hindu past will not buy the people bread, or give them jobs. Hopefully, a fairer order can emerge from the tumult, in which all of India's communities are treated equally.

These include Rahul Gandhi and leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party. They blocked access to the Jantar Mantar protest site in Delhi. About 130 million names were removed from the electoral rolls. It is said that many of them were Muslims and people from other groups that are often left out. Media reports say the Indian election commissioner ignored objections from inside the commission to removing so many voters. There are demands for his resignation. The BJP and its Hindutva allies used questionable ways in the past to remove Muslim votes. Hindutva is the idea of Hindu nationalism. They took away the right to vote from millions through the National Register of Citizens. The National Register of Citizens is an official list of citizens. The Sangh Parivar has run out of ideas. MADRID: Spain's Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Monday called a snap election for Nov 29, after parliament rejected housing relief measures proposed by his minority government amid nationwide protests.

The defeat on Friday was just the latest political setback for Sanchez, one of the few left-leaning government leaders still in power in Europe. "To do more, we need to renew and broaden the support of the people," Sanchez said in a televised address, adding that his aim was "to secure a much broader, progressive majority in parliament".

The next general election was scheduled to take place by August 2027. His announcement came after tens of thousands of people marched in Madrid and other cities on Saturday demanding action on housing affordability.

The government's proposed measures, which included automatic renewal of tenancy contracts and restrictions on evicting vulnerable tenants, were voted down by opposition parties in Spain's parliament.

The defeat infuriated the protesters and underscored the difficulties Sanchez's minority coalition government faces in passing legislation. The protests were fuelled by the eviction last month of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from the Madrid flat where she had lived for decades.

Hundreds of demonstrators have occupied a tent camp in central Madrid for more than a week, demanding housing reforms. One of them, 19-year-old student Sara Prieto Aparicio, said that she believed that calling the snap election "was the best thing to do". "There is a big mobilisation by citizens and I think this favours elections," she said.

"This wave of indignation is unstoppable and we are not going to stop," Alicia del Rio, a spokesperson for the Madrid Tenants' Union, one of the protest leaders, said while renewing a call for a general strike. Recent opinion polls have generally put the main opposition conservative Popular Party (PP) ahead of the Socialists.

The PP would likely need to partner with the far-right Vox to form a government however. Making housing the central campaign issue "could mobilise left-leaning voters", said Federico Santi, a Europe analyst at political risk consultancy Eurasia Group.

He said an early election could help limit further erosion of support for the Socialists, amid resurgent inflation, legislative deadlock and corruption scandals. Housing has become one of Spain's main political issues as supply lags demand.
output: Spain ke Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez ne 29 November ke liye snap election ka elan kiya. Snap election ka matlab hai election jo tay waqt se pehle ho. Parliament ne unki minority government ke housing relief measures reject kar diye. Minority government woh hoti hai jis ke paas parliament mein majority nahi hoti. Nayi general election August 2027 tak honi thi. Saturday ko Madrid aur doosre shehron mein tens of thousands logon ne march kiya aur demand ki ke housing affordable ho. Government ke proposed measures mein tenancy contracts ka automatic renewal aur kamzor tenants ko evict karne par restrictions shamil thin. Pichhle mahine 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal ko Madrid ke flat se evict kiya gaya. Is ne protests ko hawa di. 19-year-old student Sara Prieto Aparicio ne kaha ke snap election ka elan best decision tha. Recent opinion polls mein opposition ki conservative Popular Party (PP) Socialists se aage rahi. Opposition parties woh hoti hain jo government mein shamil nahi hoti.

input:
ISLAMABAD: Textile and clothing exporters have urged the government to introduce structural reforms and provide temporary financial support to arrest the sector's downturn and protect Pakistan's share in international markets amid mounting global competition.

The proposals were laid out at a high-level meeting, chaired by Commerce Secretary Jawad Paul, on Tuesday. The meeting reviewed challenges facing the textile industry and possible policy interventions to restore export competitiveness.

A source told Dawn that issue-based subcommittees had been constituted to examine the industry's concerns and submit recommendations within 15 days.

At the outset, exporters called for structural reforms to address the rising cost of production and at the same time, they sought immediate relief through a six to eight per cent drawback of local taxes and levies (DLTL) on total export sales, conditional upon achieving a 10pc growth in exports.

The exporters said the proposed incentive would help sustain production, encourage higher exports and prevent further erosion of the country's market share under increasingly difficult international trading conditions.

The meeting was attended, among others, by officials from the ministries of finance, power, petroleum, mines and minerals, the Federal Board of Revenue (FBR), the State Bank, and the Punjab Industries Department.

Among the industry representatives were Pakistan Textile Exporters Association Patron Khurram Mukhtar and Chairman Reehan Naseem, Pakistan Hosiery Manufacturers and Exporters Association (PHMA) Chairman Syed Zia Alamdar, Pakistan Textile Council (PTC) Chairman Fawad Anwar, and All Pakistan Textile Mills Association representatives Rehman Naseem and Aamer Fayyaz.

A major concern raised during the discussions was the industrial electricity tariff, particularly the burden of cross-subsidies that exporters said continued to undermine their competitiveness.

Industry representatives highlighted a discrepancy of Rs56 billion in power tariff calculations, of which the Power Planning and Monitoring Company (PPMC) acknowledged Rs26bn.

It was decided that the matter would now be taken up with the Power Division during a meeting scheduled for Friday (Oct 16). The commerce ministry was asked to submit recommendations to the prime minister for a final decision.

The exporters' representatives questioned the methodology used to calculate gas tariffs, particularly the treatment of unaccounted for gas losses, which they said added to industrial energy costs.

Another major issue concerned anomalies in the Export Finance Scheme (EFS), including differences in rates, inadequate allocation of funds to the corporate sector and the failure of certain commercial banks to implement the prescribed fixed financing rate of 4.5pc.

The industry representatives sought corrective measures to ensure that export financing remained accessible at competitive rates, particularly at a time when exporters were facing rising production costs and weakening demand in overseas markets.

The meeting dwelt at length on delays in tax refunds and other taxation issues involving the FBR, which exporters said had heightened liquidity pressures and constrained their ability to finance export orders.

On labour-related expenses, the industry representatives informed the meeting that the overall human resource cost had reached $270 per worker, placing an additional burden on manufacturers.
output: Textile aur kapron ke exporters ne government se structural reforms aur kuch arse ke liye paison ki madad maangi. Structural reforms ka matlab hai system mein bunyadi tabdiliyan, taake karobar asaan ho. Tuesday ko Commerce Secretary Jawad Paul ki leadership mein ek bari meeting hui. Exporters ne total export sales par 6 se 8 percent DLTL maanga, is shart par ke exports mein 10 percent izafa ho. Meeting mein finance, power, petroleum, mines aur minerals ki ministries, FBR, State Bank aur Punjab Industries Department ke officials ne hissa liya. Industry ke logon mein Pakistan Textile Exporters Association ke Patron Khurram Mukhtar, Chairman Reehan Naseem, PHMA ke Chairman Syed Zia Alamdar, PTC ke Chairman Fawad Anwar, aur All Pakistan Textile Mills Association ke Rehman Naseem aur Aamer Fayyaz shamil the. Meeting mein industrial bijli ke tariff aur cross-subsidies ke bojh par fikar zahir ki gayi. Cross-subsidies ka matlab hai ke ek group doosre group ki bijli ki qeemat ka bojh uthata hai. 56 billion rupees ke farq ka masla uthaya gaya, jis mein se PPMC ne 26 billion rupees maane. Ye masla Friday (16 October) ko Power Division ke saath uthaya jayega, aur Commerce Ministry Prime Minister ko final faisle ke liye recommendations degi. Exporters ne Export Finance Scheme (EFS) mein 4.5 percent ka fixed financing rate lagu na hone aur tax refund mein deri par bhi fikar zahir ki. Export Finance Scheme ka matlab hai exporters ko saste sood par qarz dene ka government program.

پاکستان تحریک انصاف بظاہر اس وقت اپنے مشکل ترین وقت سے گزر رہی ہے اور نو مئی کے پر تشدد واقعات کے بعد قائدین کی ایک بڑی تعداد پارٹی سے علیحدگی اختیار کر چکی ہے۔

لیکن ایسا بھی نہیں کہ سب یہی کر رہے ہیں۔ ابھی بھی پی ٹی آئی کے قائدین اور کارکنوں کی ایک بڑی تعداد ایسی بھی ہے، جو سخت حالات کا مقابلہ کر رہی ہے۔

صوبہ پنجاب اور سندھ سے اہم نام پارٹی چھوڑ چکے ہیں لیکن صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا کو ایک مختلف تناظر میں دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔

خیبر پختونخوا سے ابھی تک سابق وزیراعلیٰ پرویز خٹک نے اپنے عہدے سے استعفی دیا ہے جبکہ مالاکنڈ ڈویژن سے سابق ایم این اے حیدر علی نے پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی میں شمولیت اختیار کر لی ہے۔

باقی کوئی ایسا بڑا نام نہیں، جس نے پارٹی کو الوداع کہا ہو تاہم سابق ایم این اے علی محمد خان کی طرح، اس وقت قید و بند کا سامنا کرنے والے دیگر رہنما ضرور موجود ہیں۔

پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے سابق ایم این اے علی محمد خان کو منگل کے روز ساتویں مرتبہ گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔

ان کے وکیل ندیم شاہ ایڈووکیٹ کا کہنا ہے کہ پشاور ہائیکورٹ کو بتایا گیا ہے کہ علی محمد خان کے خلاف کوئی کیس نہیں لیکن منگل کے روز جب عدالت نے ان کی ضمانت کی درخواست منظور کی تو اینٹی کرپشن کی ٹیم نے انھیں مردان جیل کے باہر سے گرفتار کر لیا۔

خیبرپختونخوا سے سابق ایم این اے شہریار آفریدی گرفتار ہیں اور ان کے بارے میں یہ کہا جا رہا ہے کہ انھیں جیل میں انتہائی مشکل حالات میں رکھا گیا ہے۔

سابق وفاقی وزیر مراد سعید کے بھائی کو چند روز پہلے گرفتار کیا گیا۔ اسی طرح صوابی سے تعلق رکھنے والے محمد علی ترکئی کے گھر پر چھاپہ مارا گیا اور توڑ پھوڑ کی گئی۔

عاطف خان کی اسلام آباد میں فیکٹری بند کر دی گئی تھی لیکن بعد میں کھول دی گئی۔ اس کے علاوہ ڈاکٹر امجد اور دیگر متعدد افراد کو گرفتار کیا گیا ہے۔

خیبرپختونخوا سے پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے وہ قائدین جو اس وقت منظر عام سے غائب ہیں، ان سے رابطہ ہوا تو ان کا کہنا تھا کہ ان کے خلاف ہر قسم کا دباؤ بڑھایا جا رہا ہے لیکن اگر وہ پی ٹی آئی سے علیحدگی اختیار کرتے ہیں تو ان پر عوامی دباؤ بڑھ سکتا ہے اور پھر شاید وہ سیاسی طور پر انتخابات میں مقابلے کے قابل بھی نہ رہیں۔

اس بارے میں پی ٹی آئی کے رہنماؤں عاطف خان، شوکت یوسفزئی اور دیگر سے بات چیت ہوئی اور ان کا مؤقف تھا کہ وہ پی ٹی آئی اور جماعت کے چیئرمین کے ساتھ کھڑے ہیں۔

عاطف خان نے بتایا کہ ان کی اطلاع ہے کہ پرویز خٹک نے کچھ اراکین سے رابطے کیے ہیں اور بظاہر انھوں نے سیاسی صورتحال پر بات چیت کی ہے لیکن انھیں یہ معلوم نہیں کہ آیا پرویز خٹک نے ان اراکین کو پی ٹی آئی چھوڑنے کا کہا ہے۔

شوکت یوسفزئی کا بھی یہی کہنا تھا کہ پرویز خٹک کا رابطہ ہوا ہے لیکن ایسی کوئی بات نہیں ہوئی کہ انھیں پارٹی چھوڑنے کا کہا گیا ہو۔

پی ٹی آئی کے ضلعی رہنما عرفان سلیم کہتے ہیں کہ پی ٹی آئی نے گذشتہ دس سال میں جو پروگرام دیا اور اس پر اگر 100 فیصد نہیں تو 50 فیصد کام کیا اور لوگوں نے وہ دیکھا ہے جس وجہ سے لوگ آج بھی سخت حالات کے باوجود جماعت کے ساتھ جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔

ان کا کہنا تھا کہ گزشتہ دس پندرہ سال میں جو نظریاتی تعلق قائم ہے، صوبے میں لوگ اس سے جڑے ہوئے ہیں اور اس سے پیچھے ہٹنا ان سب کے لیے بہت مشکل ہے۔

پاکستان تحریک انصاف خیبر پختونخوا میں سنہ 2013 میں ایک مقبول جماعت بن کر ابھری۔ اس بارے میں پی ٹی آئی رہنما اور سابق وزیر خزانہ تیمور سلیم جھگڑا کہتے ہیں کہ جماعت نے گذشتہ نو دس سال میں لوگوں کے ساتھ ایک رشتہ قائم کیا، جو اب تک قائم ہے۔

تیمور سلیم جھگڑا کا کہنا تھا کہ خیبر پختونخوا میں جماعت کے چیئرمین کے ساتھ جو لوگوں نے رشتہ قائم کیا، وہ جماعت کی پالیسیوں کی وجہ سے ہے اگر ایسا نہ ہوتا تو شاید اب تک جماعت ختم ہو چکی ہوتی۔

ان کا کہنا تھا کہ یہاں لوگوں کا جو مزاج ہے وہ واپس روایتی سیاست کی طرف نہیں جائیں گے، ان کے جو نظریات ہیں زیادہ آزاد سوچ رکھتے ہیں اور خاص طور پر یہاں نوجوان براہ راست عمران خان کے ساتھ جڑے ہوئے ہیں۔

تجزیہ کاروں کا کہنا ہے کہ صوبے میں زیادہ ووٹ بینک اس وقت پی ٹی آئی کا ہے اور پی ٹی آئی نے اس صوبے کے لیے ایک روڈ میپ دیا تھا اوراس منشور پر عمل درآمد کے لیے کوششیں کی تھیں، جن میں سے کچھ پر عملدرآمد ہوتا نظر آیا۔
output: پاکستان تحریک انصاف، ایک سیاسی جماعت، 9 مئی کے پر تشدد واقعات کے بعد مشکل وقت سے گزر رہی ہے۔ صوبہ پنجاب اور سندھ سے اہم نام پارٹی چھوڑ چکے ہیں۔ خیبر پختونخوا سے سابق وزیراعلیٰ پرویز خٹک نے اپنے عہدے سے استعفی دیا ہے۔ وزیراعلیٰ صوبے کی حکومت کا سربراہ ہوتا ہے۔ مالاکنڈ ڈویژن سے سابق ایم این اے حیدر علی نے پاکستان پیپلز پارٹی، ایک اور سیاسی جماعت، میں شمولیت اختیار کر لی ہے۔ سابق ایم این اے علی محمد خان کو منگل کے روز ساتویں مرتبہ گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے۔ علی محمد خان کے وکیل ندیم شاہ ایڈووکیٹ نے کہا کہ پشاور ہائیکورٹ کو بتایا گیا کہ علی محمد خان کے خلاف کوئی کیس نہیں۔ عدالت نے علی محمد خان کی ضمانت کی درخواست منظور کی۔ ضمانت کا مطلب ہے کہ ملزم مقدمہ ختم ہونے تک کچھ شرائط پر جیل سے باہر رہ سکتا ہے۔ پھر اینٹی کرپشن کی ٹیم نے انھیں مردان جیل کے باہر سے گرفتار کر لیا۔ اینٹی کرپشن ایک سرکاری ٹیم ہوتی ہے جو کرپشن کی تحقیق کرتی ہے۔ تجزیہ کاروں کا کہنا ہے کہ صوبے میں زیادہ ووٹ بینک اس وقت پی ٹی آئی کا ہے۔ ووٹ بینک کا مطلب ہے ووٹرز کا وہ گروپ جو عام طور پر کسی ایک پارٹی کو ووٹ دیتا ہے۔

ISLAMABAD: The emergency proclamation issued under Article 232 applies to all of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, not just the 12 terror-stricken districts of the province, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar said on Tuesday.

Addressing a press conference alongside his cabinet colleague Attaullah Tarar, the law minister said that for those 12 districts, a special mechanism had been introduced.

"Under the chief executive, extra measures have been taken; a dedicated secretariat has been established which will be providing assistance to those districts," he said.

At the outset of the press briefing, the law minister noted that the province in the recent past had witnessed a hike in terrorist incidents, noting a "195 per cent" rise, with 8,600 terrorist attacks recorded in 2024-2026 compared to 2,900 in 2020-2024.

He emphasised that it was essential that counterterrorism efforts taken by federal and provincial agencies be "harmonised", adding that such an approach was standard practice globally.

"All these arrangements are made to run the country in a way that people feel safe," the law minister remarked, adding that the "non-serious" attitude of the PTI-led KP government "has now ceased to exist".

He recalled that the PTI, allegedly using government resources, "launched an onslaught on the capital". However, at the time, the imposition of governor's rule and emergency did not come under discussion.

Describing the situation on the ground in the province, the law minister said: "The KP police were under attack, armed forces deployed in the province were under attack […] innocent people lost their lives."

"You cannot shut your eyes after receiving such reports and seeing this rise in terrorist activity," Azam added.

Recalling the events leading up to the federal government's decision, the law minister said the government had held "constant engagement" with the provincial authorities.

"Unfortunately, their response was somewhat different. Maybe their politics were more important to them than having the national interest at heart," he said.

The information minister claimed that the people of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa had "welcomed" the federal government's move to impose governor's rule and emergency in the province, saying the measures had given them "hope".
output: Azam Nazeer Tarar said on Tuesday that the emergency under Article 232 applies to all of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Article 232 is the part of the constitution that lets an emergency be imposed in an area. Emergency means the government gets special powers. He said a special way of doing things has been set up for only the 12 districts hit by terrorism. He said extra steps were taken under the chief executive. A special office was set up to help those districts. He said terrorist incidents in the province rose by 195 percent. He said 8,600 terrorist attacks were recorded in 2024-2026, compared with 2,900 in 2020-2024. He said federal and provincial agencies must work together in their efforts against terrorism. He said the PTI-led Khyber Pakhtunkhwa government's not-serious attitude has now ended. The information minister said the people of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa called the decision to impose governor's rule and emergency good, and it gave them hope. Governor's rule means the province's administration goes into the governor's hands.

خورشید خان ایڈووکیٹ نے بی بی سی سے بات کرتے ہوئے کہا برصغیر پاک و ہند میں انگریز کے آنے سے پہلے بادشاہوں کے من چاہے طریقوں سے سزا دی جاتی تھی جبکہ انگریز کے آنے کے بعد پھانسی کی سزا مقرر کی گئی تھی۔

انھوں نے قرانی آیات کے حوالہ دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ اسلام میں مجرم کو سزا قصاص کے تحت دی جانی چاہیے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اسلام کے مطابق مجرم کو موت کی سزا ایسی دی جانی چاہیے جس میں انسان کو کم تکلیف ہو جبکہ پھانسی کی سزا انتہائی تکلیف دہ اور اذیت ناک ہے۔

برطانیہ میں سزائے موت ختم ہو چکی ہے جبکہ امریکہ میں زہریلے انجیکشن کے ذریعے دی جاتی ہے۔ پھانسی کی سزا صرف پاکستان، بھارت اور بنگلہ دیش میں ہی رائج ہے۔

خورشید خان نے اس درخواست میں اسلامی نظریاتی کونسل کے علاوہ خیبر پختونخوا کے سیکرٹری قانون اور سیکرٹری داخلہ کے علاوہ سپرنٹنڈنٹ سینٹرل جیل ہری پور اور ڈسٹرکٹ اینڈ سیشن جج اسلام آباد کو پارٹی بنایا ہے۔

ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اسلامی نظریاتی کونسل کا کام ملک میں اسلامی قوانین کے لیے راہ ہموار کرنا ہے اور اس کے لیے خیبر پختونخوا اسمبلی اور قومی اسمبلی میں قانون سازی کی جائے تا کہ موت کے اس طریقہ کار کو تبدیل کر دیا جائے۔
output: Khursheed Khan ek lawyer hain. Unhon ne BBC se baat karte hue kaha ke Indo-Pak subcontinent mein British ke aane se pehle badshah apni marzi se sazayen dete the. منگل کے روز عالمی منڈی میں تیل کی قیمتوں میں تقریباً دو فیصد اضافہ ریکارڈ کیا گیا ہے کیونکہ سعودی عرب کی تیل و گیس کی تنصیبات پر حالیہ حملوں کے بعد عالمی سطح پر سپلائی میں ممکنہ رکاوٹوں کے خدشات برقرار ہیں۔

یاد رہے کہ سعودی عرب پر ہوئے حالیہ حملوں کے نتیجے میں ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن سے تیل کی ترسیل مکمل طور پر بند ہو گئی ہے، جبکہ اس کے ساتھ ساتھ خلیجی ممالک میں جہاز رانی کے خطرات کم کرنے کی کوششوں پر بھی سوالات اٹھنے لگے ہیں۔

خبررساں ادارے 'روئٹرز' کے مطابق منگل کے روز برینٹ خام تیل کی قیمت 1.87 ڈالر (یعنی 1.77 فیصد) اضافے کے ساتھ 107.55 ڈالر فی بیرل پر ٹریڈ ہوا، جبکہ امریکی ویسٹ ٹیکساس انٹرمیڈیٹ خام تیل 1.88 ڈالر (یعنی 1.85 فیصد) اضافے کے بعد 103.27 ڈالر فی بیرل پر ٹریڈ ہوا۔

یاد رہے کہ پیر کے روز بھی برینٹ خام تیل اور امریکی ویسٹ ٹیکساس خام تیل میں ایک فیصد سے زائد اضافہ ریکارڈ ہوا تھا۔

کے سی ایم ٹریڈ کے چیف مارکیٹ تجزیہ کار ٹِم واٹرر نے روئٹرز کو بتایا کہ تیل کے تاجر ہر نئے حملے یا تیل و گیس کے بنیادی ڈھانچے کو پہنچنے والے نقصان کو سپلائی کے لیے ایک نئے خطرے کے طور پر دیکھ رہے ہیں۔

اُن کا کہنا تھا کہ مارکیٹ اس بات پر بھی گہری نظر رکھے ہوئے ہے کہ آیا سعودی عرب کی ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن اور آبنائے ہرمز کے راستے سے تیل کی ترسیل معمول پر آ سکتی ہے یا نہیں۔

تیل و گیس کی عالمی مارکیٹ کی نگرانی کرنے والی کمپنی 'کلیر' کے ابتدائی اعدادوشمار کے مطابق پیر کے روز آبنائے ہرمز سے گزرنے والے تیل و گیس بردار جہازوں کی تعداد کم ہو کر صرف چار رہ گئی، جو ایک روز قبل 10 تھی۔ اس پیش رفت نے اس اہم بحری راستے کے بارے میں خدشات میں اضافہ کر دیا ہے، جہاں ایران کے خلاف امریکہ اور اسرائیل کی جنگ شروع ہونے سے قبل دنیا کی تقریباً 20 فیصد تیل سپلائی گزرتی تھی۔

سعودی خریداروں اور تاجروں کا کہنا ہے کہ اگر ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن کی سرگرمیاں جلد بحال نہ ہوئیں تو سعودی عرب چند ہی دنوں میں برآمدات کے لیے دستیاب تیل کے ذخائر سے محروم ہو سکتا ہے۔ ایسی صورت میں عالمی منڈی سے تقریباً چار فیصد تیل سپلائی کم ہونے کا خدشہ پیدا ہو سکتا ہے۔

دنیا کا سب سے بڑا تیل برآمد کرنے والا ملک سعودی عرب ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن کے ذریعے روزانہ تقریباً 40 لاکھ بیرل تیل، جو عالمی سپلائی کا تقریباً چار فیصد بنتا ہے، بحیرہ احمر کے ساحلی بندرگاہی شہر ینبع تک منتقل کرتا رہا ہے۔

مالیاتی ادارے آئی این جی کے تجزیہ کاروں نے ایک نوٹ میں کہا ہے کہ ابھی تک یہ واضح نہیں کہ سعودی پائپ لائن کو پہنچنے والا نقصان کس حد تک سنگین ہے اور اس لائن کی بندش کتنے عرصے تک جاری رہ سکتی ہے۔

یاد رہے کہ سنیچر کو ہونے والے حملے کے بعد سعودی حکام نے 'ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن' کو بند کر دیا تھا۔

یہ حملہ ایسے وقت میں ہوا تھا جب یمن کے حوثیوں کے سعودی عرب پر حملوں میں شدت آ رہی ہے جس سے مشرقِ وسطیٰ تنازع مزید پھیل رہا ہے۔

دوسری جانب عراق نے اپنی سرزمین سے اس حملے کی تصدیق کے بعد ایک فوجی کمانڈر کو برطرف کر کے تحقیقات شروع کی تھیں۔ عراقی حکام کے مطابق یہ حملہ ایران سے متصل عراق کے صوبے میسان سے کیا گیا تھا۔

سعودی عرب دُنیا کا سب سے بڑا خام تیل برآمد کرنے والا ملک ہے اور 1200 کلومیٹر طویل 'ایسٹ ویسٹ پائپ لائن' سعودیہ کو آبنائے ہرمز سے گزرے بغیر یعنی متبادل گزرگاہ تیل کی سپلائی کا راستہ فراہم کرتی ہے۔

یہ واقعہ یمن میں ایران کے حمایت یافتہ حوثی باغیوں کی بڑی پیش قدمی کے دوران پیش آیا تھا جس سے عالمی تیل کی ترسیل کے راستوں پر مزید دباؤ بڑھ گیا۔

اس مقام کے قریب جلی ہوئی زمین اور دھوئیں کی سیٹلائٹ تصاویر بھی سامنے آئی تھیں۔

سعودی وزارتِ خارجہ نے کہا تھا کہ حملے کے نتیجے میں کچھ افراد زخمی ہوئے اور نقصان بھی ہوا، جس کا تخمینہ ابھی لگایا جا رہا ہے۔

سعودی عرب کی یہ پائپ لائن جسے عراق سے آنے والے ڈرونز کے ذریعے نشانہ بنایا گیا تھا، کی اہمیت اُس وقت سے مزید بڑھ گئی ہے جب مشرقِ وسطیٰ میں امریکہ اور اسرائیل کی ایران کے خلاف جنگ جاری ہے۔

یہ پائپ لائن جو 'پیٹرولائن' کے نام سے بھی جانی جاتی ہے، سعودی عرب کے مشرقی صوبے میں واقع ابقیق کے میدانوں سے مغرب میں واقع بندرگاہ ینبع تک جاتی ہے۔

input:
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Saturday that Tehran supports a "political process" to resolve the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Houthi rebels.

The Houthis have repeatedly attacked Saudi targets, including energy facilities and Riyadh's international airport, where 13 people were killed in amajor attacklast week.

"We support an inclusive and comprehensive political process as the only practical and sustainable way to resolve the issue," Araghchi said in a speech at the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation in Baghdad.

Araghchi repeated Iran's offer to mediate between the two sides. Deputy Foreign Minister Saeed Khatibzadeh previously said Riyadh has not responded to Iran's overture.

On Friday, Iran denied having anything to do with the Houthi attacks, after Saudi ArabiaaccusedTehran of encouraging the group's escalation.

In his speech, Araghchi also said "either we build security together, or we will endure insecurity together," adding that Tehran was willing "to cooperate with all its brothers and neighbours to achieve the first option".

The Houthis have repeatedly attacked Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers after a truce in their long-running war with Yemen's coalition governmentunravelledin July.

On Wednesday, Yemen's Houthi rebels said they hadtargetedfacilities belonging to Saudi Aramco, after Saudi officials reported a strike on a building in Riyadh housing the energy giant's operations centre.

Powerful explosions also rattled the Saudi capital, as the coalition fighting the Houthis said it had intercepted a missile fired by the group towards Riyadh.

On Tuesday, Saudi Arabialaunchedstrikes on Houthi-controlled areas of Yemen, targeting fuel and energy facilities it said were being used to support missile and drone attacks, as the Yemeni group threatened a "harsh and painful" response against Saudi airports, refineries and oil installations.

Hours later, Saudi authorities issued warnings of potential hostile aerial threats in the kingdom's eastern province and Riyadh.

Loud explosions were heard near Saudi Aramco's headquarters in Dhahran, according to witnesses. Later, a Saudi energy ministry official confirmed the attack. Saudi Arabia's civil defence agency said that four people — two women, a man and a child — were wounded by debris from two intercepted Houthi cruise missiles in the capital and that 15 homes were damaged.
output: Iran ke Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi ne Saturday ko kaha ke Tehran Saudi Arabia aur Yemen ke Houthi rebels ke jhagre ko suljhane ke liye political process ka saath deta hai. Houthi rebels Yemen ka ek group hain jo wahan ki hukumat ke khilaf larte hain. Houthis ne Saudi targets par hamle kiye hain. In mein energy facilities aur Riyadh ka international airport shamil hain. Riyadh Saudi Arabia ka capital hai. Pichhle hafte ek bade hamle mein wahan 13 log mare gaye. Baghdad mein Organisation of Islamic Cooperation se baat karte hue Araghchi ne kaha ke poora political process hi is masle ka sirf ek practical aur lambay arsay tak chalne wala hal hai. Organisation of Islamic Cooperation Islamic mulkon ka ek group hai. Araghchi ne Iran ki taraf se dono sides ke darmiyan mediation ki peshkash dohrai. Mediation ka matlab hai ke koi teesra party jhagre ko suljhane ki koshish kare. Misal ke taur par, do padosi larte hon aur koi teesra banda un ke darmiyan sulah karane ki koshish kare, to yeh mediation hai. Deputy Foreign Minister Saeed Khatibzadeh ne pehle kaha tha ke Riyadh ne Iran ki peshkash ka jawab nahi diya. Friday ko Iran ne Houthi hamlon mein shamil hone se inkar kiya. Yeh Saudi Arabia ke Tehran par ilzam lagane ke baad hua ke woh group ko hamle tez karne ka hausla de raha hai. July mein Yemen ki coalition government ke saath lambi jung mein ceasefire tootne ke baad, Houthis ne Saudi airports, oil facilities aur tankers par bar bar hamle kiye hain. Yemen ki coalition government ka matlab hai woh government jise doosre mulk mil kar support karte hain. Ceasefire ka matlab hai ke larai kuch waqt ke liye band ho jaye. Wednesday ko Yemen ke Houthi rebels ne kaha ke unhon ne Saudi Aramco ki facilities ko target kiya. Isi waqt Saudi officials ne Riyadh mein ek building par hamle ki khabar di. Saudi Aramco Saudi Arabia ki oil company hai. Tuesday ko Saudi Arabia ne Yemen ke Houthi-controlled areas par hamle kiye. Saudi civil defence ne kaha ke Riyadh mein do Houthi cruise missiles ke malbe se char log — do khawateen, ek mard aur ek bacha — zakhmi hue. 15 ghar mutasir hue.

ISLAMABAD: The lower house of parliament witnessed lacklustre proceedings on Friday, with only three federal ministers in attendance, after two days of bustling National Assembly sessions to approve the proclamation of emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

While it was expected that senior government and opposition lea­­ders would continue their hea­ted speeches on the proclamation of emergency and governor's rule, not a single MNA from either side of the aisle spoke on the matter.

The proceedings began at 11.35am, over half an hour behind schedule, with around 50 to 60 MNAs — including Defence Minister Khawaja Asif, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar and Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry from the treasury benches and fewer than 15 opposition members — present in the house.

Leader of the Opposition Mahmood Achakzai and the top PTI leadership were absent.

It was expected that the law minister would speak on the floor of the house if any opposition member raised the issue of emergency and governor's rule in KP. However, as no lawmaker spoke on the matter, the law minister also remained silent.

The proclamation of emerge­n­­cy in KP was endorsed by the Nat­ional Assembly and the Senate on Wednesday, while governor's rule was approved by a joint sitting of the two houses on Thursday. All these sessions witnessed heavy attendance by lawmakers.

During Question Hour, the decline in tourism in Pakistan overshadowed proceedings when PPP MNA Dr Nafisa Shah raised the issue of the lack of interest shown by foreign tourists in visiting the country.
output: جمعہ کے روز ایوان زیریں میں کارروائی سست رہی۔ ایوان زیریں یعنی قومی اسمبلی۔ صرف 3 وفاقی وزیر موجود تھے۔ کارروائی 11:35am پر شروع ہوئی، جو شیڈول سے آدھے گھنٹے سے زیادہ تاخیر سے تھی۔ تقریباً 50 سے 60 ایم این اے موجود تھے۔ ایم این اے قومی اسمبلی کے رکن کو کہتے ہیں۔ ان میں وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف، وزیر قانون اعظم نذیر تارڑ اور وزیر پارلیمانی امور طارق فضل چوہدری شامل تھے۔ اپوزیشن کے 15 سے کم ارکان موجود تھے۔ قائد حزب اختلاف محمود اچکزئی اور پی ٹی آئی کی اعلیٰ قیادت غیر حاضر تھی۔ ایمرجنسی اور گورنر راج پر حکومت یا اپوزیشن کے کسی ایم این اے نے بات نہیں کی۔ ایمرجنسی کا اعلان اس وقت ہوتا ہے جب کسی علاقے میں معمول کے انتظامات کی جگہ ہنگامی اختیارات استعمال کیے جائیں۔ گورنر راج اس وقت لگتا ہے جب صوبے کی منتخب حکومت کی جگہ گورنر کے ذریعے انتظام چلایا جائے۔ قومی اسمبلی اور سینیٹ نے بدھ کو خیبر پختونخوا میں ایمرجنسی کا اعلان منظور کیا۔ جمعرات کو دونوں ایوانوں کے مشترکہ اجلاس نے گورنر راج کی منظوری دی۔ سوالیہ وقفہ کے دوران پی پی پی کی ایم این اے ڈاکٹر نفیسہ شاہ نے پاکستان میں سیاحت میں کمی اور غیر ملکی سیاحوں کی دلچسپی نہ ہونے کا مسئلہ اٹھایا۔

برطانوی خبر رساں ایجنسی روئٹرز کے مطابق قطیف کے علاقے عوامیہ میں جمعرات کو سکیورٹی فورسز نے ایک ایسے شخص کو گولی مار کر ہلاک کر دیا جو عوامیہ میں مسلح افراد اور سکیورٹی فورسز کے درمیان جھڑپوں میں مقامی رہائشیوں کو بس محفوظ مقام پر منتقل کر رہا تھا۔

روئٹرز کے مطابق سال کے آغاز پر غیر ملکی میڈیا کو قطیف جانے کی اجازت تھی لیکن ان کے ساتھ سکیورٹی کے نام پر سرکاری حکام کا ہونا ضروری ہوتا تھا۔

انسانی حقوق کی تنظیم ہیومن رائٹس واچ میں مشرق وسطیٰ پر ریسرچ کرنے والے ایڈم کوگل کا کہنا ہے کہ سعودی عرب کے دیگر علاقوں اور قطیف میں جو چیز مختلف ہے وہ ہے قطیف میں جگہ جگہ چیک پوسٹیں۔ ان چیک پوسٹوں کے ذریعے سکیورٹی فورسز مقامی آبادی کی نقل و حمل پر نظر رکط سکتی ہے اور جیسے ہی کشیدگی میں اضافہ ہوتا ہے تو چیک پوسٹوں پر بکتر بند گاڑیاں کھڑی کر کے چیکنگ سخت کر دی جاتی ہے۔

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with no knowledge of international relations: explain the key terms and actors in simple words.
input:
PESHAWAR: PTI Chai­r­man Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Wednesday mov­ed the Peshawar High Co­u­rt (PHC) against the imposition of emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, req­u­esting the court to declare the move unconstitutional.

The emergency, decl­ared on Sunday, follows heightened tensions between the PML-N-led federal government and the PTI-led KP government. The Centre and opposition have been at odds over various issues, particularly the counterterrorism policy, which was one of the main reasons cited by both parties behind the breakdown of their Oct 3 talks.

Advocate Shah Faisal Ilyas on behalf of the PTI chairman submitted the petition requesting the PHC to declare the Oct 11 emergency proclamation as "unconstitutional, ultra vires, coram non judice, tainted with malice in law and fact, devoid of objective material, and of no legal effect".

The court was further urged to set the proclamation aside.

Barrister Gohar is represented by a panel of lawyers, including Barrister Sameer Khosa, Salman Akram Raja, Ali Zaman, Sardar Haseeb Ahmad and Zainab Shahid.

As grounds for the petition, Barrister Gohar contended that the issuance of such a proclamation was subject to the "indispensable condition precedent of a prior resolution passed by the provincial assembly of that province".

"No such resolution was ever moved, debated, or passed by the provincial assembly of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa," he contended.

Filed under Article 199 (jurisdiction of high court) of the Constitution, the petition named the Federation of Pakistan (through the secretaries of the Cabinet, law ministry, interior ministry and defence ministry); the province of KP; KP Governor Kundi; the KP Assembly speaker; and the secretary of the KP home and tribal affairs department as respondents.

Sohail Afridi, the now non-functional chief minister of the province following the imposition of governor's rule, was also named as a pro forma respondent.

Barrister Gohar challenged the "constitutionality, legality and vires" of the Oct 11 Proclamation of Emergency in the province, the order deploying army troops to the province, and "all consequential and derivative executive orders, notifications, and bodies" constituted as a result, including the establishment of the KP Advisory Council and the "arbitrary" detention and unseating of Mr Afridi as the chief minister.

He urged the court to order the immediate constitutional restoration of Mr Afridi as the lawful chief minister of KP, along with his provincial cabinet, with full executive powers.

The plea urged the PHC to restrain the federation from "tabling, entertaining, or enacting any provincial legislative business concerning Khyber Pakhtunkhwa in Parliament".

The court was requested to declare as illegal and unconstitutional and to set aside, dissolve or permanently restrain all executive orders, notifications, actions, and bodies created "pursuant to or under the colour of" the proclamation.

The petitioner also challenged the Oct 11 order of army deployment under Article 245, requesting the court to declare it as unconstitutional on the basis that it could not "supplant or bypass the civilian executive and constitutional administration" of the province, and could not be invoked in the absence of a lawful requisition by Mr Afridi-led government.

He also sought directives for the immediate release of Mr Afridi and members of the KP cabinet and assembly from "unlawful executive or preventive detention".
output: Barrister Gohar Ali Khan PTI ke chairman hain. PTI Pakistan ki ek political party hai. Wednesday ko unhone Peshawar High Court mein petition file ki. Petition Khyber Pakhtunkhwa mein emergency aur governor's rule lagne ke khilaf thi. Unhone court se kaha ke ise unconstitutional declare kiya jaye. Emergency ka matlab hai ke crisis ke waqt government ko kuch special powers mil jati hain. For example, emergency aisi hoti hai jaise flood ke waqt government ko foran faislay karne ke liye special power mil jaye. Governor's rule ka matlab hai ke province ka intezam kuch waqt ke liye governor ke haath mein chala jata hai. Unconstitutional yaani constitution ke khilaf. Emergency Sunday ko lagayi gayi thi. Uske baad federal government aur KP government ke darmiyan tension barh gayi. Petition lawyer Shah Faisal Ilyas ne PTI chairman ki taraf se file ki. Petition mein request ki gayi ke 11 October ke emergency elaan ko unconstitutional aur bina legal asar ke declare kiya jaye. Petition Article 199 ke under file ki gayi. Article 199 constitution ka woh hissa hai jo High Court ko government ke khilaf order dene ka power deta hai. Is mein Federation of Pakistan, KP province, KP Governor Kundi, KP Assembly speaker aur KP Home and Tribal Affairs Department ke secretary ko respondent banaya gaya. Respondent yaani woh log jinhein court mein jawab dena hota hai. Sohail Afridi ko bhi pro forma respondent banaya gaya. Pro forma yaani formally. Petition mein 11 October ke army deployment ke order aur KP Advisory Council banane ko challenge kiya gaya. Advisory Council yaani mashwara dene wali council. Petition mein request ki gayi ke Sohail Afridi ko KP ka Chief Minister wapas banaya jaye. Aur unko aur KP cabinet aur assembly ke members ko foran release kiya jaye.

انڈین کی بحریہ نے دو دنوں میں دو کشتیوں کو بحری قزاقوں سے آزاد کروایا ہے جن میں 19 پاکستانی ماہی گیر بھی صومالی بحری قزاقوں کی قید سے بحفاظت آزاد کروائے گئے۔

پاکستانی ماہی گیروں کی کشتی کو بحری قزاقوں کی جانب سے صومالیہ کے ساحل کے قریب ہائی جیک کر لیا گیا تھا۔

انڈین بحریہ کی جانب سے یہ گذشتہ 36 گھنٹوں میں دوسرا ریسکیو آپریشن تھا۔

انڈین بحریہ کا کہنا ہے کہ اس تازہ کارروائی سے چند گھنٹے قبل انڈین بحری جہاز 'سمترا' نے بحری قزاقوں کی گرفت سے 17 ایرانی ماہی گیروں کو بھی بازیاب کروایا تھا۔

گذشتہ چند ہفتوں کے دوران انڈین بحریہ نے ملاحوں اور ماہی گیروں کی کشتیوں کی جانب سے کی جانے والی مدد کی اپیلوں پر متعدد بار سمندر میں کارروائیاں کی ہیں۔

حالیہ دنوں میں صومالیہ کی ساحلی حدود میں ہونے والے قزاقوں کے حملوں میں اضافہ ہوا ہے جس سے اِن خدشات میں اضافہ ہوا ہے کہ شاید اس علاقے میں قزاق ایک مرتبہ پھر متحرک ہو گئے ہیں۔

انڈین بحریہ کا جہاز 'آئی این ایس سمترا' کو میری ٹائم سکیورٹی آپریشنز کے لیے صومالی ساحل اور خلیجِ عدن میں تعینات کیا گیا ہے۔

انڈین بحریہ نے سماجی رابطوں کی ویب سائٹ ایکس پر اپنے بیان میں بتایا کہ انھیں 28 جنوری کو ایک پریشان کُن پیغام ملا جس کا جواب دیا گیا اور معلوم ہوا کہ یہ کال ایرانی جھنڈے والی ایک کشتی کی طرف سے کی گئی ہے۔

انڈین بحریہ کا کہنا ہے کہ اس کے افسران نے 'قزاقوں کو جہاز پر موجود عملے کو کشتیوں کے ساتھ بحفاظت رہا کرنے پر مجبور کیا۔'

انڈین بحریہ نے اپنے بیان میں مزید کہا کہ ایرانی عملے کی رہائی کے بعد اُن کی کشتی کا معائنہ کیا گیا اور انھیں سفر جاری رکھنے کی اجازت دے دی۔

تاہم انڈین بحریہ کی جانب سے جاری بیان میں یہ تفصیلات نہیں دی گئیں کہ بحری قزاقوں کے ساتھ کیا کیا گیا۔

انڈین بحریہ کے مطابق آئی این ایس سمترا کو منگل کو سمندر میں ایک اور کارروائی کرتے ہوئے ماہی گیروں کی النعیمی نامی کشتی کو ڈھونڈا اور اس میں سوار 19 پاکستانی شہریوں کو 11 صومالی بحری قزاقوں کی قید سے آزاد کروایا۔

اس مرتبہ بھی انڈین بحریہ نے قزاقوں کے حوالے سے تفصلات فراہم نہیں کیں لیکن سوشل میڈیا پلیٹ فارم 'ایکس' پر جاری ایک تصویر میں نیوی کے افسران کو کچھ افراد کی حفاظت کرتے ہوئے دیکھا جا سکتا ہے جن کے ہاتھ رسیوں سے پشت پربندھے ہوئے تھے۔
output: The Indian Navy, which is India's sea force, rescued two boats from pirates in two days. It safely freed 19 Pakistani fishermen from being held by Somali pirates. The Pakistani fishermen's boat had been hijacked near the coast of Somalia. The Indian Navy says this was the second rescue operation in the past 36 hours. The Indian ship 'Sumitra' had freed 17 Iranian fishermen from being held by pirates. The Indian Navy ship 'INS Sumitra' is deployed along the Somali coast and in the Gulf of Aden for maritime security operations. Maritime security operations means military actions to protect ships and people at sea. For example, patrolling the sea to protect ships is one such action. On January 28, the Indian Navy responded to a worrying message. The message came from a boat flying the Iranian flag. According to the Indian Navy, on Tuesday INS Sumitra freed 19 Pakistani citizens on board the fishing boat Al-Naeemi from being held by 11 Somali pirates.

instruction: Explain this news in Urdish (Urdu in Roman letters, mixed with common English words) for a reader with no knowledge of international relations: explain the key terms and actors in simple words.
input:
ISLAMABAD: Pakistan and Malaysia on Friday agreed on a roadmap to deepen trade and investment relations, identifying key areas of cooperation at a business conference.

Malaysian High Commissioner Dato Mohammad Azhar Mazlan, who led the 'Malaysia-Pakistan Business Engagement 2026', said bilateral trade could be increased substantially from $1.5 billion to $5bn through enhanced commercial engagement and greater private sector participation.

He stressed the need to translate the longstanding friendship into stronger trade and investment partnerships, noting Pakistan's importance as a major South Asian trading partner.

He identified artificial intelligence, education, manufacturing and services as promising areas for collaboration, noting that Pakistan's geographical position as a gateway to Central Asian markets and its young population were major strengths.

Referring to opportunities in the edible oil and halal products sectors, he encouraged Pakistani businesses to explore Malaysia, citing Pakistani investment in halal gelatine production there as an example of successful cross-border ventures. He said a win-win approach should remain central to economic engagement.

Minister for Investment Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh said Pakistan and Malaysia shared considerable potential to expand commercial engagement, develop joint ventures and strengthen their presence in regional and global markets.

He identified information technology, artificial intelligence, advanced technology, manufacturing, value-added industries, mining and minerals, agriculture, food processing and halal products as sectors offering substantial potential for joint ventures.

He said Malaysia's technological expertise could complement Pakistan's natural resources, workforce and large consumer market. Pakistan, he added, welcomed high-quality Malaysian investment that contributes to industrial development, technology transfer, employment generation and export growth.
output: Pakistan aur Malaysia ne Friday ke din trade aur investment ke relations deeper karne ke liye ek roadmap par agree kiya. Roadmap ek plan hota hai jis mein aage kya karna hai uska outline hota hai. Malaysia ke High Commissioner Dato Mohammad Azhar Mazlan ne 'Malaysia-Pakistan Business Engagement 2026' ki lead ki. High Commissioner ek ambassador jaisi position hoti hai. Unhon ne kaha ke bilateral trade 1.5 billion dollars se barha kar 5 billion dollars ki ja sakti hai. Bilateral trade ka matlab do mulkon ke darmiyan kharidna aur bechna hai. Unhon ne artificial intelligence, education, manufacturing aur services ko mil kar kaam karne ke liye achhe mauqe bataya. Unhon ne Pakistan ko Central Asian markets ka gateway aur young population ki wajah se important bataya. Minister for Investment Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh ne kaha ke Pakistan aur Malaysia ke darmiyan joint ventures banane aur regional aur global markets mein presence strong karne ka potential hai. Joint venture mein do mulkon ki companies mil kar business karti hain. For example, do mulkon ki companies mil kar ek nayi factory lagayen to yeh joint venture hai. Unhon ne information technology, artificial intelligence, advanced technology, manufacturing, value-added industries, yaani aisi industries jin mein cheezon ki value barhai jati hai, mining aur minerals, agriculture, food processing aur halal products ko joint ventures ke liye sectors bataya. Unhon ne kaha ke Pakistan high-quality Malaysian investment ko welcome karta hai jo industrial development, technology transfer, jobs aur exports barhane mein madad de. Technology transfer ka matlab ek mulk se doosre mulk technology pahunchana hai.
